0.0: Hey! What brings you here to see me? Ah, you want to know about the scroll pieces, do ya?

yes.0: You can obtain a #b#t04001136##k from the gift box I give when you log in everyday or by hunting Maple World's most wanted master monsters.
yes.1: If you collect #b30#k #b#t04001136#s#k, I can use magic to make you a #bWeapon ATT Scroll#k that has a 60% success rate. Of course, I can't tell you what kind of scroll it'll be.

no.0: Why did you come to see me if you weren't even curious?

1.0: You're done collecting scroll pieces? I'm impressed! Now I will make you a scroll, as promised.

yes.0: You received the scroll, didn't you? If you find more scroll pieces, bring them to me before October 26th. So long!
